title: Zoning text change for 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens, paired with a related zoning map change. It would help enable a seven-story mixed-use building with about 33 apartments, including 8 income-restricted units, and 11,500 square feet of community facility space. The Council held a public hearing on October 6, 2026.
